question.worked_solution:
First, we isolate the absolute value on the left side of the equation:

$$
\begin{aligned}|5-x|-8 & =7 \\ |5-x| & =15\end{aligned}
$$

Now, we have the following two cases:

- If $|5-x|=5-x,$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|5-x| & =15 \\ 5-x & =15 \\ -x & =10 \\ x & =-10\end{aligned}
$$

- If $|5-x|=-(5-x),$ we obtain:

$$
\begin{aligned}|5-x| & =15 \\ -(5-x) & =15 \\ -5+x & =15 \\ x & =20\end{aligned}
$$

Therefore, in ascending order, the solutions are $x=-10$ and $x=20.$
